title: AmberX as an empty shell for building and testing plugins
asked: The amberx app is supposed to be an empty shell with voice commands only with banner, toolbar, nav menu and application menu and context menu, minimal everything, just the basic settings asset, theme, layout stuff, basic context menu, that's it. It's for building and testing plugins. Keep the Approvals page (and its alerts) and the whole Monitoring plugin; remove only the rest.

steps.text: Map amberx-droid and check for clashes
Strip Hub, Apps, Manage; trim chrome assets

result.summary: AmberX is an empty shell for plugins: kept banner, toolbar, nav, app menu, basic context menu, settings, theme/layout/style assets, voice + monitor plugins (WatchService untouched), Approvals + alerts. Removed Hub, Apps, Manage pages, Asset studio, Account view, demo dialogs; chrome assets trimmed. README plugin how-to.
